taxonomy_summary: Platypus niijimai Murayama, 1931. Original publication and subsequent nomenclatural qualifications are documented below.

nomenclature_note: Murayama (1931:198) reported an attacked tree under the printed name Psidium guajacum. Its relationship to a currently accepted botanical name is unresolved; the historical original host spelling is retained.
